'''Clawdite''' was the written and spoken [[language/Legends|language]] of the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdites]], the [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]] genetic variant [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Zolander]]s from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> It was a modified form of [[Zolanese/Legends|Zolanese]].<ref name="scum" /> Spoken Clawdite contained hissing [[Wikipedia:Sibilant|sibilants]] and guttural croaks.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clawdite was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[April]], [[2003]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> Clawdite was first identified as being a modified form of Zolanese in [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']], a sourcebook for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition'']] of the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game'' published by Wizards of the Coast on [[November 18]], [[2008]].<ref name="scum" />
